Abstract

Schedule a new job according to cache and data locality awareness.

Claims

1. A method comprising caching data on compute nodes and scheduling a job using data locality.
2. The method of claim 1, further comprising transferring missing data.

Description

[0001] The invention relates to distributed computing.
[0002] Existing systems repeatedly transfer remote data.
